title: Position-Skipped Distillation of Sparse-Attention Indexers: Train Short, Serve Long
abstract: arXiv:2611.29664v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Top-k sparse attention relies on an indexer, a lightweight per-layer module that ranks cached tokens so attention covers only the k highest-scoring ones. Indexers are usually distilled from dense attention at the full serving length, so every training step pays for long-context dense attention. We show that when an indexer is distilled on short sequences, its failure to generalise to longer contexts is driven mainly by rotary positional encoding (RoPE), not by degraded content matching. We propose position-skipped distillation: the indexer and the frozen teacher see short sequences whose position IDs contain a randomly placed gap, so neither ever processes more than the short training length. On DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Qwen3-30B-A3B, an indexer distilled on 8K tokens this way matches a 32K-distilled indexer to within about 0.5 perplexity up to 32K, and on DeepSeek-V2-Lite matches a 64K-distilled indexer at 64K with roughly 6x less training

translated_title: 稀疏注意力索引器的跳位蒸馏：短训练，长服务
translated_abstract: Top-k 稀疏注意力依赖于一个索引器——一个轻量的逐层模块，它对缓存的 token 进行排序，使注意力只覆盖得分最高的 k 个 token。索引器通常是在完整服务长度下从稠密注意力蒸馏而来，因此每个训练步骤都要承担长上下文稠密注意力的计算开销。我们证明，当索引器在短序列上蒸馏时，其无法泛化到更长上下文的问题主要由旋转位置编码导致，而非内容匹配能力退化。我们提出跳位蒸馏方法：索引器与冻结的教师模型只处理位置 ID 中包含随机放置间隔的短序列，因此两者处理的长度都不会超过短训练长度。在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上，用这种方法在 8K token 上蒸馏的索引器在 32K 以内与 32K 蒸馏的索引器困惑度差距约为 0.5 以内，并且在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 上，以约 6 倍更少的训练成本在 64K 处达到与 64K 蒸馏索引器相当的效果。
tldr: 该论文提出跳位蒸馏方法，通过让索引器与冻结教师在位置 ID 含随机间隔的短序列上训练，发现索引器长上下文泛化失败主要源于 RoPE 位置编码而非内容匹配退化，从而实现“短训练、长服务”，以约 6 倍更少的训练成本即可匹配长序列蒸馏的索引器效果。
